source_policydoc: Directive 2010/75/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council
justification: The implementation of the Directive 2010/75/EU can reinforce the Farm to Fork Strategy by reducing pollution from industrial activities, which in turn can aid in achieving the strategy's objectives of reducing the environmental impact of food production.

source_policydoc: On the quality of water intended for human consumption
justification: The implementation of the water quality directive can enable the Farm to Fork Strategy by ensuring access to clean water for irrigation and other agricultural purposes, creating conditions for sustainable food production.

source_policydoc: Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan
justification: The Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan can indivisibly support the Farm to Fork Strategy by promoting sustainable food systems, reducing pollution, and protecting biodiversity, which are all crucial for achieving the strategy's objectives.

source_policydoc: European assessment framework for ‘safe and sustainable by design’ chemicals and materials
justification: The European assessment framework may counteract the Farm to Fork Strategy by promoting the use of chemicals in food production, which could hinder the strategy's objective of reducing the environmental impact of food production.

source_policydoc: On reporting of environmental data from industrial installations and establishing an Industrial Emissions Portal
justification: The implementation of the Industrial Emissions Portal can enable the Farm to Fork Strategy by providing data on industrial emissions, which can inform policies to reduce pollution from food production.

source_policydoc: on ambient air quality and cleaner air for Europe
justification: The ambient air quality directive can reinforce the Farm to Fork Strategy by reducing air pollution from agricultural activities, which can aid in achieving the strategy's objectives of improving air quality.

source_policydoc: Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan
justification: The Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan can indivisibly support the Farm to Fork Strategy by promoting sustainable food systems, reducing pollution, and protecting biodiversity, which are all crucial for achieving the strategy's objectives.
